dqRubric.naRules: Judge the quality of the world art and its visual communication, excluding playable software implementation and factual compliance already assessed by these rules.

requirementChecks.criteria: Deliver exactly the 6 named independent items for tier 6. Duplicate exports do not add items. Only six final static artworks are commissioned; no process, video or presentation is required.
Use the explicitly marked final version; if none is marked, use the last exported version.
Each static role is a separate complete export. Multi-view technical boards are allowed where commissioned; do not count one contact sheet or duplicate export as several roles.

Each applicable sheet must visibly identify its asset and provide distinguishable front, side and rear depictions, both labeled states, a useful detail enlargement and a readable map icon. A state may share a view if both requirements remain clear. Match the records: C01 Council Scout, 1720 mm, Idle/Reading; C02 Brine Diver, 1840 mm, Idle/Sampling; C03 Ring Rigger, 1760 mm, Idle/Lifting; C04 Fibre Gatherer, 1680 mm, Idle/Winding; C05 Algae Tender, 1810 mm, Idle/Tending; C06 Core Archivist, 1740 mm, Idle/Indexing. Props: P01 Tide Gauge, 240 × 90 × 45 mm, Stowed/Reading; P02 Shell Sampler, 360 × 100 × 100 mm, Closed/Sampling; P03 Cell Cradle, 300 × 180 × 120 mm, Empty/Loaded; P04 Fibre Reel, 220 × 160 × 160 mm, Stowed/Winding; P05 Pressure Lamp, 280 × 140 × 140 mm, Dim/Lit; P06 Core Caddy, 260 × 180 × 80 mm, Closed/Open. Dimensions must be legible and proportions credible. Missing components, incorrect records or duplicate views presented as different orientations fail. At tier 6, captions on both asset sheets must also contain #D8CDA8, #397C86 and #766B83.

Require a perspective scene and a dimensioned route inset on each plate. Read the title, region and tide labels: S01 is Salt Flats/Turning Tide, S02 Undersea/Low Tide and S03 Orbital Ruins/High Tide. Their footprints must respectively read 48000 × 32000 mm, 36000 × 24000 mm and 24000 × 32000 mm. The inset must describe the depicted route rather than an unrelated diagram. S01 shows a salt storm, wind-carved pillars and a route into ring-fragment shelter; S02 shows an open sinkhole and ledge toward pressure shells beside luminous water; S03 shows flooded lower machinery and an airlock raised within reach on a floating segment. Composition may vary; wrong labels, dimensions, tide access or an unusable depicted route fail.

Track the same scout and gauge across their sheets, all three scenes and both device views. C01 must retain the sand coat with split hem, teal forearms, exactly one spool on the anatomical left shoulder and a left-upper-arm Council badge. P01 must retain the oval body, round dial, exactly three lower slots and wrist strap. Require both assets in every scene. Pose, perspective and plausible occlusion may vary; mirrored accessories, altered counts, replacement silhouettes or absent featured assets fail. Regional color assignments and the scenes' principal light direction must agree with the fixed art facts.

Read every device view independently: each must show SALT MOON, Read tide, Collect sample, Low Tide, 08:00 and Samples 3 / 12 in an Undersea snapshot depicting C01 reading P01 and sample collection. Read tide is at lower left and Collect sample immediately above it. Controller A maps to reading and X to collection; touch uses a tap-hand icon for each; the tier-24 keyboard and mouse sheet uses E and F respectively. Match action positions and the snapshot across views, allowing device-specific control glyphs. Every sheet needs a labeled legend: Low Tide uses an open downward triangle in #D8CDA8, Turning Tide three diagonal strokes in #766B83, and High Tide a filled upward triangle in #397C86. Missing per-view wording, altered countdown or sample count, swapped bindings, displaced actions or incorrect legend pairings fail.

Check text and control symbols against their actual local backgrounds in both device views. Ordinary text must meet 4.5:1; large text and icons must meet 3:1. The unavailable collection example must visibly retain the Collect sample label, include a lock icon and meet 3:1 rather than relying on faint text alone. Apply the recorded minimum rendered text sizes of 18 pixels for ordinary interface text and 36 pixels for text treated as large. A readable-looking but demonstrably below-threshold treatment fails; do not claim an exact contrast measurement from appearance alone.

Where equipment is depicted, fittings must read as matte brine metal and straps as woven fibre. The Council badge must retain a circular ring with top and bottom gaps and three centered horizontal bars, the middle bar longest, using the recorded #26383D identity color. Characters wear it on the left upper arm; props carry it on a circular inset plate on the main body. Regional character and prop colors retain shared sand #D8CDA8 and teal #397C86 accents. Lighting and perspective may affect appearance; replacement badge geometry, mirrored placement, glossy fittings or visibly incompatible strap material fail.

Painted world and asset depictions must use broad, opaque strokes and visibly chipped material edges, while interaction silhouettes remain crisp enough to read. Directional highlights and shadows must establish an upper-left principal light, particularly in every scene plate. Undersea bioluminescence may add subordinate local glow but must not replace or contradict that principal direction. Do not require painterly strokes on plain typography or diagram lines. Incompatible rendering treatment or a conflicting dominant scene light fails.

Keep each region recognizable through its assigned dominant palette and signature material: pale sand #D8CDA8 with salt glass on the surface Flats, teal #397C86 with pressure shells in the underground sea, and violet-gray #766B83 with vacuum-scarred alloy in fallen orbital-ring ruins. Preserve the Flats' two-moon sky identity when the sky is visible, the Undersea's cavern and luminous-water identity, and the Ruins' half-buried ring geometry and dead machinery. Secondary colors, weather and local glow may vary without swapping regional assignments. Surface-ocean replacement, an above-ground Undersea, intact orbiting ruins presented as the playable region, or loss of the stated regional material identity fails.

C01 and P01 keep their sheet-defined identities and relative scale wherever they appear. Painted depictions share opaque brushwork, chipped edges, matte brine-metal fittings, woven straps and the recorded Council badge. Regional colors and materials remain correctly assigned, and all scene plates use upper-left dominant light.
